text: Databases store and organize information so we can use it easily. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways. To get information, we write queries, which are questions the database answers. Data modeling means planning how to structure your data before you build the database. Indexes help the database find data faster, like an index in a book. Choosing the right database and design makes your applications work better and faster.
